default.description: Use to create a shadow when content scrolls under other content.

perimeter.description: Use only when elevation.shadow.overflow is not technically feasible to implement. Pair with elevation.shadow.overflow.spread to replicate the overflow shadow.

spread.description: Use only when elevation.shadow.overflow is not technically feasible to implement. Pair with elevation.shadow.overflow.perimeter to replicate the overflow shadow.

overlay.description: Use for the box shadow of elements that sit on top of the UI, such as modals, dropdown menus, flags, and inline dialogs. Combine with elevation.surface.overlay Also use for the box shadow of raised cards in a dragged state.

raised.description: Use for the box shadow of raised card elements, Combine with elevation.surface.raised

disabled.description: Apply to image when in a disabled state.

loading.description: Apply to content that sits under a loading spinner.
